name: Question 1
problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14082081/assets/8de0dad0436135ef40aa26666d10659f4041275a915de153b6b4b45312c1c52f.png)

Evaluate ${∬}_{D}{x}^{2}y\,dA,$ where $D$ is the region shown in the picture above.
worked_solution:
The region $D$ can be partitioned into three type II regions ${D}_{1},$ ${D}_{2},$ and ${D}_{3},$ as shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14082081/assets/b58fc3909d5be467999053336f67d41b88b43c984208c60f3d46ee8b7479df58.png)

As a result, we get 

$$
{D}_{1}={(x,y)\,:\,0\le y\le 1,\,-2\le x\le -1},
$$

$$
{D}_{2}={(x,y)\,:\,0\le y\le 1,\,1\le x\le 2}
$$

and 

$$
{D}_{3}={(x,y)\,:\,1\le y\le 3,\,-2\le x\le 2}.
$$

Therefore, using the additivity property of double integrals, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{D}{x}^{2}y\,dA & ={∬}_{{D}_{1}}{x}^{2}y\,dA+{∬}_{{D}_{2}}{x}^{2}y\,dA+{∬}_{{D}_{3}}{x}^{2}y\,dA \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{-2}^{-1}{x}^{2}y\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y+{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{1}^{2}{x}^{2}y\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y+{\int }_{1}^{3}{\int }_{-2}^{2}{x}^{2}y\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{[\frac{y\text{ }\,{x}^{3}}{3}]}_{-2}^{-1}\,\text{d}y+{\int }_{0}^{1}{[\frac{y\text{ }\,{x}^{3}}{3}]}_{1}^{2}\,\text{d}y+{\int }_{1}^{3}{[\frac{y\text{ }\,{x}^{3}}{3}]}_{-2}^{2}\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}\frac{7y}{3}\,\text{d}y+{\int }_{0}^{1}\frac{7y}{3}\,\text{d}y+{\int }_{1}^{3}\frac{16y}{3}\,\text{d}y \\  & =2\cdot \frac{7}{3}\cdot {[\frac{{y}^{2}}{2}]}_{0}^{1}+\frac{16}{3}\cdot {[\frac{{y}^{2}}{2}]}_{1}^{3} \\  & =\frac{7}{3}+\frac{64}{3} \\  & =\frac{71}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

EXPLANATION

The region D can be partitioned into three type II regions D1, D2, and D3, as shown below.

As a result, we get

D1={(x,y):0≤y≤1,−2≤x≤−1},

D2={(x,y):0≤y≤1,1≤x≤2}

and

D3={(x,y):1≤y≤3,−2≤x≤2}.

Therefore, using the additivity property of double integrals, we obtain

∬Dx2ydA=∬D1x2ydA+∬D2x2ydA+∬D3x2ydA=∫01∫−2−1x2ydxdy+∫01∫12x2ydxdy+∫13∫−22x2ydxdy=∫01[y x33]−2−1dy+∫01[y x33]12dy+∫13[y x33]−22dy=∫017y3dy+∫017y3dy+∫1316y3dy=2⋅73⋅[y22]01+163⋅[y22]13=73+643=713.
